mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quota_operation (operation_no, account_id, idempotency_scope, request_id, idempotency_key_hash, request_hash, service_key, price_version, amount, status) VALUES (#{operationNo}, #{accountId}, #{idempotencyScope}, #{requestId}, #{idempotencyKeyHash}, #{requestHash}, #{serviceKey}, #{priceVersion}, #{amount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, operation_no, account_id, idempotency_scope, request_id, idempotency_key_hash, request_hash, service_key, price_version, amount, status, debit_log_id, refund_log_id, create_time, update_time FROM quota_operation WHERE request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE quota_operation SET debit_log_id = #{debitLogId} WHERE id = #{id} AND debit_log_id IS NULL
